title: Generic Galois group of a finite local etale henselian residue lift
statement:
Let $(H,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] that is a normal domain (an integral domain integrally closed in its field of fractions) [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], and put $K=\operatorname{Frac}(H)$. Let $B$ be a local finite etale $H$-algebra, meaning finite as an $H$-module with $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}H$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose an identification $B/\mathfrak mB\simeq e$ is given, where $e/\kappa$ is a finite Galois field extension [def-pc-field-extension], meaning finite separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal (every minimal polynomial over $\kappa$ of an element of $e$ splits in $e$). Then $B$ is a normal domain, $H\to B$ is injective, and $E=\operatorname{Frac}(B)=K\otimes_HB$ is a finite Galois extension of $K$ with $[E:K]=[e:\kappa]$. The ring $B$ is the integral closure of $H$ in $E$: it consists exactly of the elements of $E$ satisfying a monic polynomial over $H$. Extension to fractions and reduction give group isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{Gal}(E/K)\simeq\operatorname{Aut}_H(B)\simeq\operatorname{Gal}(e/\kappa).$$
Here the first map restricts automorphisms to $B$, and the second is their action on $B/\mathfrak mB$.
